LanguageData.RK_Research_Agriculture.label: Agriculture
LanguageData.RK_Research_Agriculture.description: Make farming tools to speed up farming work and getting more yield.
LanguageData.RK_Research_Smithing.label: Ratkin smithing
LanguageData.RK_Research_Smithing.description: Build exclusive ratkin smithies to craft metal tools and basic weaponry.
LanguageData.RK_Research_Tailoring.label: Ratkin apparel
LanguageData.RK_Research_Tailoring.description: Ratkin clothing that is easy to wear. Produces basic clothing that fit onto ratkin.

LanguageData.RK_Research_FoodPreservation.description: Make hardtack, a mixture of water and flour to create a longlasting meal that doesn't go back for a while. Great for traveling.
LanguageData.RK_Research_Metallurgy.label: Ratkin metallurgy
LanguageData.RK_Research_Metallurgy.description: Create plate armor for your ratkin.
LanguageData.RK_Research_SwordAndShield.label: Sword and shield
LanguageData.RK_Research_SwordAndShield.description: Craft swords and shields for ratkin.
LanguageData.RK_Research_FunctionalApparel.label: Functional apparel
LanguageData.RK_Research_FunctionalApparel.descriptio: Allows the tailoring of professional clothes that impart work bonuses.
LanguageData.RK_Research_AdvancedApparel.label: Advanced apparel
LanguageData.RK_Research_AdvancedApparel.description: Research methods to imitate the armor found on the humans. Need Ratkin glasses to research.
LanguageData.RK_Research_Fortification.label: Emplacements
LanguageData.RK_Research_Fortification.description: Build emplacements like cannons and mounted ballistas.
LanguageData.RK_Research_NobleApparel.label: Noble apparel
LanguageData.RK_Research_NobleApparel.description: Antique, enhanced clothing. Antique clothes for combat and diplomacy. Need Ratkin glasses to research.
LanguageData.RK_Research_RatkinEngineering.label: Ratkin engineering
LanguageData.RK_Research_RatkinEngineering.descriptio: Craft simple firearms that can only be equipped exclusively by ratkin
LanguageData.RK_Research_GearMechanics.label: Wheel mechanics
LanguageData.RK_Research_SeparationMechanics.label: Separation Mechanics
LanguageData.RK_Research_SeparationMechanics.descript: Enables projectile separation functionality. Unlocks AP/Airburst round toggle for the multipurpose sniper rifle.
LanguageData.RK_Research_DragonFlame.label: Wyvern's Fire
LanguageData.RK_Research_DragonFlame.description: Make Wyvern's Fire and assemble Gunlances. Gunlances are melee weapons with the ability to shoot out Wyvern's Fire, a highly explosive and flammable mixture that catches anything - or anyone - on fire.
LanguageData.RK_Research_OrbitalEquipment.label: Ratkin orbital tech
LanguageData.RK_Research_OrbitalEquipment.description: Make vacsuits designed to fit onto ratkin and protect against the harsh vacuum of space.
LanguageData.RK_Research_AngryRatProject.label: Angry Rat Project
LanguageData.RK_Research_AngryRatProject.description: Make highly dangerous weaponry like chainswords and bolters.
